orchestrator_note: Clean. R3 was the load-bearing rule of this chapter and the critic was asked to check its three clauses separately — two witnesses, who stood at that station, signing before the surveyor leaves it. It was also asked to rule on two borderline R4 questions: Fowler's 'till noon and not past it', and Dent's 'you'd call it seven weeks', which is a number but a duration rather than a distance. Neither was found to violate a clause.
